summary.text: Nan mountain demonic Gu Masters whose boss is rank four, named when they claim a captive at San Cha mountain's foot.

claims.text: When Fang Yuan and Bai Ning Bing stand watching at the foot of San Cha Mountain, the Ten Tyrants members pale as they take in black cloth, black hair and black eyes beside white cloth, silver hair and blue eyes. Onlookers weigh Ten Tyrants against the black and white twin demons and say that without the boss they are no match for the twins. Fang Yuan looks back at the Ten Tyrants members, says he will not make a move, and asks them to give him a good show.

Hearing Fang Yuan refuse to intervene, some Ten Tyrants members soften, and one pins the female Gu Master. Another cups his fists toward Fang and Bai, saying they will report that act of friendship to their boss. The woman then reveals rank four aura, sends the Ten Tyrants members flying, and leaves them weak on the ground. Watchers ask why the Ten Tyrants provoked Hu Mei Er, and the members understand they were toyed with to probe the black and white demons.

In a cave on San Cha mountain the Ten Tyrants gather, and leader Tyrant Heng Mei hears they were used by Hu Mei Er to test the Black and White Demons, with seventh and tenth brother injured. He slaps the second brother, says this is San Cha mountain not Nan mountain, and warns that Kong Ri Tian, Long Qing Tian, Wu Shen Tong, and Yi Chong can kill them like ants, and that they stay here because of him. He forbids trouble with Hu Mei Er because of her ties to Lin San Chi, Li Xian, and Mo Wu Tian. He then says the Ten Tyrants of Nan mountain cannot take this lying down and will go find the black and white demons, planning to visit personally, mention working together against Hu Mei Er, and use the young pair as vanguard.

Outside Fang Yuan’s cave, Tyrant Heng Mei announces he came to pay a visit. Bai Ning Bing recalls he is boss of Ten Tyrants, cultivates strength path, likes to eat little children’s flesh, and has spread fear over Nanshan. Eight people stand outside; at the front is a robust figure with rank four middle stage aura, and narration says he commanded the other nine members of Ten Tyrants and lorded over Nan mountain for many years.

Fang Yuan challenges a life and death battle and attacks. Fang Yuan fights Tyrant Heng Mei while Bai Ning Bing suppresses the remaining members. Bai Ning Bing kills the other members and locks Tyrant Heng Mei down as Fang Yuan’s six beast phantoms beat him to a pulp, with internal organs and bone fragments on the ground.

Narration later says Tyrant Heng Mei from Ten Tyrants visited little beast king out of goodwill but was killed, and that little beast king used initial stage cultivation to kill rank four middle stage Gu Masters outright.
